title: Her Blue Sky UK Collectors Blu-ray Will Be Released on Monday
content:
The film is described as follows:

"Second-year high school student Aoi Aioi is an aspiring musician. Her older sister Akane's ex-boyfriend Shinnosuke Kanomura is a struggling guitarist. Aoi and Akane's parents passed away in an accident 13 years ago, and Akane gave up her ambition of going to Tokyo with Shinnosuke to take care of Aoi. Since then, Aoi has felt indebted to her older sister.

"One day, she is invited to perform at a music festival as a session musician by a famous en singer named Dankichi. At the same time, Shinnosuke returns to Aoi and Akane's town after a long time away. Then, Shinno mysteriously appears- who is actually Shinnosuke from 13 years ago after traveling from the past to the present-and Aoi falls in love for the first time."

Director Tatsuyuki Nagai , writer and director Mari Okada , and artist Masayoshi Tanaka — the members of Super Peace Busters — handled the film. Nagai directed, Okada penned the script, and Tanaka drew the original character designs and served as chief animation director. CloverWorks was in charge of animation production. Shion Wakayama , Riho Yoshioka , and Ryō Yoshizawa star in the film.

"At the Queen's request, Ciel and Sebastian investigate the Werewolves' Forest, where all who enter suffer a deadly curse. But when Ciel falls victim, Sebastian must serve a witch to obtain the cure, only to uncover secrets more dangerous than magic."

Daisuke Ono and Maaya Sakamoto are reprising their respective roles as the butler and demon Sebastian Michaelis and British noble Ciel Phantomhive.

Kenjirō Okada ( March comes in like a lion , RWBY: Ice Queendom ) once again directed the anime at CloverWorks . Returning staff from the Black Butler: Public School Arc anime included Hiroyuki Yoshino , who was again in charge of the series script, Yumi Shimizu as character designer, and Ryo Kawasaki , who again composed the music.

The Black Butler anime adapts Yana Toboso 's manga of the same name. The series premiered in Japan in 2008, and Black Butler II followed in 2010. Black Butler: Book of Circus premiered in 2014. Funimation has released all three television anime, the Black Butler II OAV project, the Black Butler: Book of Murder OAV , and the Black Butler: Book of the Atlantic anime film on home video.

"A seventh Singularity has been discovered in ancient Mesopotamia in the year 2655 B.C.

"The land of Uruk, governed by the wise King Gilgamesh after he returned from his quest for immortality, was grand and prosperous until three goddesses and countless Demonic Beasts appeared. These enemies have brought Uruk to the brink of destruction. With a Rayshift—a method of traveling across both time and space—Fujimaru and Mash journey to the land of Uruk, where they encounter the fortress city of Uruk and the Absolute Demonic Front, where a terrible battle against the fearsome onslaught of the Demonic Beasts rages."

CloverWorks ( DARLING in the FRANXX , PERSONA 5 the Animation ) produced the television anime series, with lead character designer Takeshi Takeuchi (Fate anime franchise ). Toshifumi Akai (assistant director DARLING in the FRANXX , Porter Robinson's "Shelter" director) directed the series, with assistant director Miyuki Kuroki ( The Idolm@ster SideM director). Tomoaki Takase ( Occultic;Nine , Saekano: How to Raise a Boring Girlfriend ) was the character designer. Keita Haga ( Fate/stay night theme song lyrics) and Ryo Kawasaki ( Fate/Grand Order: First Order ) composed the music. Unison Square Garden performed the opening theme song "Phantom Joke."

title: Re:Zero Studio to Return in 2027 With New Dark Fantasy (First Look Revealed)
content:
Established in 2007, the animation studio White Fox has climbed to the ranks of one of the most renowned studios in the industry. While Re:Zero -Starting Life in Another World- is unarguably its biggest project ever, the studio is also praised for several critically acclaimed shows, such as Steins; Gate, Girls’ Last Tour, Katanagatari, and more. The studio also returned with a new fantasy, Magical Explorer, this month as part of the Fall 2026 lineup. The anime doesn’t have nearly enough hype due to its themes and mixed reviews. However, with Re:Zero’s latest sequel in the works, the studio is sure to bounce back in no time.

While fans await the return of Re:Zero with another sequel, White Fox confirmed yet another major project, which is going to be the next big fantasy, How I Became King by Eating Monsters. Not to mention that it will turn out to be one of the darkest series from the studio. The anime was officially announced last week with a stunning visual that perfectly portrays the intense themes of the story. An official website has also been launched to keep viewers updated with all the latest announcements regarding the premiere.

title: Attack on Titan Kicks Off New World Tour With Classy Makeover
content:
Based on the acclaimed manga written and illustrated by Hajime Isayama, the anime adaptation of Attack on Titan reached unprecedented heights of popularity after its debut in 2013. While the first three seasons of the anime were adapted by WIT Studio, the final season saw a massive change. Due to the tight deadline, WIT Studio washed its hands of its flagship show, and MAPPA took it over. MAPPA wrapped up the entire story in the best way possible, preserving the legacy of this beloved show. However, while the story has long since ended, both seasons often return with new projects and exciting updates for fans.

Although there’s no hope for the anime’s return yet , the series has kicked off its first-ever orchestral concert tour of the series titled Attack on Titan: Symphony from Paradis . The project was announced in May this year, and it was confirmed to be produced by Wild Faery, an international production and promotion company that specializes in official live-to-film and symphonic concert experiences. The project kicks off with a gorgeous new visual of the beloved characters, as it puts Armin Arlet at the center as the conductor. It also includes Eren, Mikasa, and Levi in their uniform from before the time-skip, while the Colossal Titan is standing behind them.

Attack on Titan Is Holding Its First-Ever Orchestral Concert

The tour will take place in several regions in the USA, Europe, and Asia, starting from London’s Royal Albert Hall on October 17th, 2026. The official X handle of Wild Faery drops the latest visual to hype up the project while also confirming that the tickets at Royal Albert Hall have already been sold out. However, the orchestra will be held at various places until August next year, so make sure to check the ticket availability and schedule at the official website of Wild Faery . While the anime has previously held performances that blend rock and orchestra, the new concert will feature a full orchestra arrangement curated by the original composers. Over 100 musicians will participate in the performance, which is all the more reason why fans are hyped for this latest project.

Attack on Titan Has Another Major Project Planned For the Year

Although it’s impossible for the anime to return with a story since Isayama never created a sequel or spin-off after the manga’s ending, not even for one chapter. He has yet to return with a new story as well, although fans are eagerly awaiting their return. However, thanks to these new projects and visuals, Attack on Titan is still relevant to this day. Both animation studios revive the series in theatres with new versions of the already released episodes or compilations, but that’s all we can expect from the anime right now. While fans are enjoying updates on the world tour, we also can’t forget that MAPPA has another surprise planned for fans.

The studio will adapt the final storyline for the upcoming game, Attack on Titan 3 . The game is all to set to be released on December 10th, 2026, which gives fans something new to look forward to this year. Additionally, the series is also listed among the MAPPA projects that will be displayed during the 15th anniversary Expo. Even after the new project from MAPPA, we can expect more updates in the future, especially since September 9th has been declared as the official Attack on Titan Day. Not only will fans commemorate the series’ legacy on that day, but the franchise will keep returning with new projects.

title: Kino's Journey Light Novel Duo Launch New Supernatural Novel Series
content:
Kadokawa 's Dengeki Bunko imprint announced on Friday that Kino's Journey light novel duo writer Keiichi Sigsawa and illustrator Kouhaku Kuroboshi will launch a new light novel series titled Drifted ~John Smith no Edo Hyōryū Kitan~ (Drifted ~Strange Tale of John Smith's Drifting in Edo~). The first volume of the new series will ship on November 10.

The story centers on a man who wanders aimlessly, and the truths he witnesses, as he joins forces with ninjas, supernatural yōkai entities, and preternatural-powered beings to carry out his "jobs."

Sigsawa began serializing Kino's Journey in ASCII Media Works ' Dengeki HP magazine in 2000, and Kadokawa shipped the 24th volume in September 2025. The novel series inspired a 13-episode anime in 2003, followed by movies in 2005 and 2007. A remake television anime premiered in 2017. Sigsawa also published a spinoff series of the novels titled Gakuen Kino about Kino as a high school girl from 2006 to 2021. A manga adaptation of Gakuen Kino launched in Dengeki G's Festival! Comic magazine in 2010. The manga ended with its third compiled book volume in June 2012.

Iruka Shiomiya launched the first manga adaptation of the light novel series in Kodansha 's Shonen Magazine Edge in March 2017.

Yen Press recently announced on Friday that it has licensed the original novel series. Tokyopop published the beginning of the novel series in North America. ADV Films released the television anime adaptation. Sentai Filmworks rereleased the anime on DVD in June 2017.

Sigsawa and artist Hayato Asaki recently launched the Kemono-tachi no Peregrinatio (Peregrinatio Bestiarum or The Beasts' Wandering) manga on Shogakukan 's Weekly CoroCoro Comic online magazine on July 17. This is the first original manga written by Sigsawa.

title: One Piece’s Fall 2026 Replacement Anime Is Here, and It Couldn’t Be More Perfect
content:
The One Piece anime ended its run in the summer of 2026 as part of its new schedule of releasing only 26 episodes per year. Now, in its absence, it is being replaced by an anime of the same caliber, with some even arguing that it is better. It is odd to see the One Piece anime go months without releasing new episodes, something the series has consistently done for 26 years. However, fans have become accustomed to its absence since earlier this year and are appreciating its new formula. Yet, there still needs to be something that can replace the anime.

However, given the caliber One Piece has established over its run of more than two decades as the forefront of Weekly Shonen Jump, modern anime that have established their own patterns within the shonen genre can hardly replace what it has achieved. This makes older franchises the only perfect contenders. That is why the new anime from Dragon Ball , the remastered Dragon Ball Super , which began airing in fall 2026, is the only series that can perfectly replace One Piece ‘s legendary presence. It seems that even the anime industry knows this, as Dragon Ball Super: Beerus is replacing One Piece in a literal sense as well.

One Piece Anime Gets Replaced by Its Predecessor Anime This Fall

In many ways, the Dragon Ball franchise is not just One Piece ’s predecessor but also that of shonen anime as a whole , as it helped pave the way for the genre and shape what it has become today. However, given that both Dragon Ball and One Piec e are produced by Toei Animation, Dragon Ball is truly its predecessor. Now, starting October 11 this fall, Dragon Ball will replace One Piece on Sundays, taking over the exact time slot One Piece left behind when it went on hiatus. Honestly, no other series could be more fitting, as Dragon Ball will ensure that Sundays retain the nostalgic vibe One Piece has been providing.

What makes the series’ presence even more nostalgic is that the currently airing Dragon Ball Super: Beerus is a remastered version of the original 2015 Dragon Ball Super anime. In this remastered version, fans will get a total of 19 episodes, which will conclude by mid-February, condensing the original run’s 37 episodes. Looking closer, it seems that its run might actually be calculated as well. Since One Piece is promising to release 26 episodes per year, which requires six months of airing, One Piece could return to its time slot in spring 2027 after Dragon Ball ‘s run ends in winter.

This is further reinforced by the fact that Dragon Ball Super ’s next anime, which will adapt the manga’s canon Galactic Patrol arc , is set to arrive sometime in fall 2027, meaning it could once again take over the time slot One Piece leaves behind. This seems likely to become a recurring pattern as both franchises continue to evolve, meaning that for years to come, fans could see One Piece replaced by Dragon Ball remakes or new anime, or vice versa, keeping the nostalgic and legendary shonen anime vibe alive all year round.

title: 3 Anime to Watch If You Miss Delicious in Dungeon
content:
There’s no denying that Delicious in Dungeon is one of the biggest fantasies of the 2020s. While the manga has already ended, the anime will be returning with a second season next year. Fans are already hyped for the anime’s return as the first season reached its conclusion with a major cliffhanger after Laois and his party thought of an unconventional way to save Falin after her soul fused with the red dragon. The story begins with Laois and his party raiding the dungeon to save Falin. In order to survive in the dungeon with no money and resources, they consume monster meat, which is can be a delicacy depending on the cooking method.

However, as the story continues, the tone of the story shifts into something more mysterious and intense while Laois and the others uncover the darkest secrets of the dungeon during their quest of saving Falin. The first season of the anime adapted 52 chapters of the manga withing 24 episodes, wrapping up the season with the Sixth Floor Arc. Since the manga has a total of 97 chapters, the second season might wrap up the entire story if Studio Trigger decides to have the same episode count as the first season. However, so far, the anime hasn’t confirmed any details yet since Season 2 will be released only a year later. However, since there’s still a year fans have to wait for the sequel , these three anime with a similar vibe to Delicious in Dungeon will keep you occupied for a while.

3) Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End

This Shonen fantasy is just as big of a series as Delicious in Dungeon , if not more. The anime premiered in 2023 and it has released two seasons since then. Surprisingly enough even Frieren will be returning with a third season in October 2027 as well. The anime stands out for its unique worldbuilding and complex power systems as it takes fans on epic journeys, blending classic adventure themes with modern animation and complex narrative. The second season reached its conclusion with a major cliffhanger after teasing the most powerful obstacle Frieren will face in her new journey. The third season will adapt the fan-favorite Golden Land Arc from the manga, which will be set in a city that has been turned to gold by a mysterious power. The anime has already introduced Mahat, one of the Seven Sages of Destruction and a central character in the Golden Land Arc.

2) Campfire Cooking in Another World with My Absurd Skill

When it comes to isekai series, this gourment adventure falls short in popularity compared to those shows that primarily focus on action. Despite the fact that MAPPA, the same studio behind Jujutsu Kaisen and Attack on Titan Final Season, is behind this isekai, it doesn’t have nearly enough popularity as it deserves. This surprisingly heartwarming story follows Tsuyoshi Mukoda, who used to be an ordinary salaryman before being summoned to another world. After his life took a drastic turn, he made a name for himself with his exceptional cooking while also making all kinds of unique friends who fall in love with his cooking. However, it just so happens that cooking isn’t the only thing Mukoda is good at since his strength always attracts the attention of guilds around him, since he is able to keep cooking all kinds of monster meat by doing odd jobs for them.

1) Toriko

This forgotten Shonen Jump classic is a culinary delight as it stands out for its themes of adventure, focused on hunting and cooking, while exploring its unique world-building and power system. The story takes place in a world full of delectable and rare ingredients that are found in the stomachs of volcanoes. The world has reached the Gourmet Age, an era of exploration where everyone, including chefs, seeks to taste and prepare the finest dishes known to humanity. On the other hand, it’s the job of Gourmet Hunters to collect the best ingredients from even the most dangerous regions. The story follows Toriko, who is one such Gourmet Hunter who possesses a unique set of skills and is infamous for discovering 2% of all known ingredients. While the series has completely different tone and setting from Delicious in Dungeon , it does follow the characters hunting monsters for food, which takes viewers on a unique culinary adventure.

Do you agree with our picks – or have an anime you’d like to recommend that share similar vibes to Delicious in Dungeon ? Let us know in the comments below.

2) Campfire Cooking in Another World with My Absurd Skill

When it comes to isekai series, this gourment adventure falls short in popularity compared to those shows that primarily focus on action. Despite the fact that MAPPA, the same studio behind Jujutsu Kaisen and Attack on Titan Final Season, is behind this isekai, it doesn’t have nearly enough popularity as it deserves. This surprisingly heartwarming story follows Tsuyoshi Mukoda, who used to be an ordinary salaryman before being summoned to another world. After his life took a drastic turn, he made a name for himself with his exceptional cooking while also making all kinds of unique friends who fall in love with his cooking. However, it just so happens that cooking isn’t the only thing Mukoda is good at since his strength always attracts the attention of guilds around him, since he is able to keep cooking all kinds of monster meat by doing odd jobs for them.
1) Toriko

This forgotten Shonen Jump classic is a culinary delight as it stands out for its themes of adventure, focused on hunting and cooking, while exploring its unique world-building and power system. The story takes place in a world full of delectable and rare ingredients that are found in the stomachs of volcanoes. The world has reached the Gourmet Age, an era of exploration where everyone, including chefs, seeks to taste and prepare the finest dishes known to humanity. On the other hand, it’s the job of Gourmet Hunters to collect the best ingredients from even the most dangerous regions. The story follows Toriko, who is one such Gourmet Hunter who possesses a unique set of skills and is infamous for discovering 2% of all known ingredients. While the series has completely different tone and setting from Delicious in Dungeon , it does follow the characters hunting monsters for food, which takes viewers on a unique culinary adventure.
Do you agree with our picks – or have an anime you’d like to recommend that share similar vibes to Delicious in Dungeon ? Let us know in the comments below.

title: Naruto Unveils Big Future Plans for Years to Come With Special Trailer – Watch
content:
Naruto is on the cusp of a huge comeback for the franchise, and it’s touting even more big reveals and projects to come with the start of a whole new initiative for it all. Naruto was one of the key anime franchises that had something to showcase during the New York Comic Con 2026 weekend , but it arguably had the biggest panel with some of the biggest announcements. But even with all that had been revealed this weekend, there’s still much more to come our way in the coming years.

Naruto took the stage during the New York Comic Con 2026 weekend to announce Project Rasengan , a new endeavor that will be resulting in new anime, video game, and manga releases over the next few years. Teasing to be slated out for as far as 2019, Project Rasengan is giving fans a look into the huge future for the franchise with a special trailer that you can check out below to see the full scope of the kinds of plans they have so far.

Naruto Unveils Project Rasengan for Teases of 2027-2029 Projects

Project Rasengan was revealed during Naruto’ s New York Comic Con 2026 panel, and it was teased that it would be including new projects through to at least 2029. For an example of the kinds of projects we’ll see as part of this new initiative, the first releases include the start of the new Naruto Card Game, a worldwide launch of a new mobile game, and even the release of a brand new Naruto anime that will actually be featuring a surprise crossover with the Shonen Jump classic hit, Ninku . But release dates for each have yet to be finalized for now.

NARUTO x NINKŪ is a four episode crossover event series that will be combining Masashi Kishimoto’s Naruto series and Koji Kiriyama’s Ninku series. Both creators oversaw the original story that fans will see in action, and this is the shape that the previously announced Naruto anime revival took while it has been in production following its indefinite delay announcement a few years ago. Original Ninku anime series director Noriyuki Abe will be directing the new crossover with Tetsuya Nishio (who also worked on the original series) will be providing the character designs.

What’s Next for Naruto?

There’s something even bigger planned for the future, however, as Masashi Kishimoto is returning to the franchise for a brand new manga series . Naruto Shadow Rising is a new series that takes place after the events of the original series, but before the events of the Boruto: Naruto Next Generations sequel. This will be exploring the time period that fans have never gotten to see in action before, and it’s quite exciting for what it could mean for the ongoing future of this expanding story.

Naruto will be revealing more updates about their Project Rasengan works during Jump Festa 2027 later this December, so fans will hopefully get a much more concrete update about when fans can hope to see many of these new releases finally make their debuts. There’s also a new live-action feature film now in development, so it’s likely to fit within these coming Project Rasengan plans if everything works out .

What are you hoping to see from Naruto ‘s future? What kinds of new anime or manga would be great to get? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: One Piece Dub Confirms New Elbaph Arc Cast Ahead of Premiere
content:
One Piece ‘s English dub is preparing to make its return with new episodes later this month, and it’s beefing up the Elbaph Arc cast ahead of its premiere. One Piece made its grand return earlier this Spring with the start of the Elbaph Arc from Eiichiro Oda’s original manga. It kicked off a new era for the franchise now that the anime has shifted to a new seasonal release schedule with only a set number of episodes planned for each year . That also resulted in a change to its English dub schedule too.

One Piece has wrapped up its season for the year ahead of the Fall , but thankfully it won’t be too much longer before the English dub of the anime returns for its own take on the Elbaph Arc. One Piece took the stage during the New York Comic Con 2026 weekend, and it was here that the dub confirmed that Dawn M. Bennett and Ray Chase would be joining the series as the voices of Gunko and Shamrock respectively. Two members of the Knights of God.

One Piece English Dub Reveals Gunko and Shamrock Voice Actors

One Piece: Elbaph Arc officially wrapped up its 26 episode debut season earlier this Summer, and the dub is finally going to kick off its own release . It’s going to first begin with the dubbed release for the One Piece Heroines anime special releasing with Crunchyroll on October 13th at 9AM PT. It will then continue with the official start of the Elbaph Arc with One Piece Episode 1156 making its debut with Crunchyroll on October 20th at 9AM PT. Episodes of the dub will then be releasing on a weekly basis through the rest of the Fall slate.

New episodes of One Piece: Elbaph Arc will be streaming with Crunchyroll on Tuesdays at 9AM PT for fans in the United States , Canada, Australia, New Zealand, South Africa, India, Southeast Asia, and Latin America. Due to the major shift in production for the anime overall, the dub has been adjusted as well. But with the franchise wrapping up its run earlier this Summer, it also means that the dub can airing on a steady basis without any hiccups in its release. And after catching up with the Japanese broadcast a few years ago, this has been a great way for fans to keep up.

One Piece: Elbaph Arc Season 2 Continues in 2027

Following the final episode of One Piece: Elbaph Arc ‘s debut season, it was then confirmed that One Piece will be returning for its next season of episodes in 2027 . No release date or window has yet to be announced as of this time, but the series will be releasing 26 new episodes when it returns. Toei Animation revealed that they will only be producing 26 episodes of the anime a year from now on, but the pacing of each episode has been sped up to make sure the anime covers the same amount of ground each year.

One Piece is also planning a much bigger return for the anime next year. One Piece Film God Valley has been announced as a new feature film hitting theaters in Japan in 2027. This is the first of two new movies now in development , and this one is teasing it will be taking on the massive God Valley Flashback from Eiichiro Oda’s original manga series.

Will you be tuning into the One Piece English dub when it returns for new episodes this month? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: A Legendary Isekai Just Returned With New Reboot After 31 Years – Watch Opening
content:
A legendary Isekai anime series has officially made its return to screens after over three decades, and it’s kicked off its Fall return with an epic new opening theme. The Fall 2026 anime schedule is now underway as fans are now seeing all sorts of new releases making their highly anticipated debuts , and this includes the returns of some long dormant franchises too. CLAMP’s Magic Knight Rayearth is a legendary Isekai series that wrapped up its anime back in the 1990s, and now it’s back with a whole new anime.

Magic Knight Rayearth has returned for a new reboot anime series now streaming for the Fall 2026 anime schedule, but the premiere episode came and went without the official reveal of its new opening theme sequence. Ahead of the anime’s second episode, the official YouTube channel representing the series has dropped the new opening theme sequence early to get fans in the perfect mood for what’s to come. You can check it out in action below.

Magic Knight Rayearth Reboot Debuts New Anime Opening

The new opening theme for Magic Knight Rayearth (which you can watch in the video above) is titled “Otome no Ken” as performed by Toaka. The ending theme will likely be fully revealed with the debut of the second episode later this week, but it’s titled “Seira” as performed by Yurina Kawaguchi. If you wanted to check it out as the new episodes air this Fall, you can find the reboot series streaming exclusively with Crunchyroll . There’s also an English dub release planned for the reboot coming at a later date.

Using CLAMP’s now classic manga series as the base, the Magic Knight Rayearth reboot is directed by Yui Miura for E&H Production ( Ninja Kamui, Bullet/Bullet ) with Kadokawa and TMS Entertainment overseeing its production. Shigeru Murakoshi is handling the scripts with Satomi Watabe handling the character designs, and Yuki Kajiura, Takumi Ozawa and Shiho Terada composing the music. The premiere episode fully introduced this new fantasy world when its three young leads suddenly find themselves transported to a mysterious new fantasy world.

Why Is Magic Knight Rayearth So Special?

Although it can be considered as an influential Isekai anime and manga franchise, Magic Knight Rayearth is not usually in the conversations when talking about the more modern takes on the Isekai formula. These days we’ve seen so many more shows about protagonists being whisked away to a new world or being reincarnated as some ultra powerful being , but Magic Knight Rayearth is a bit different. It’s a trio of characters with distinct personalities and abilities of their own, so it’s fun to see them figure everything out.

This new era of Magic Knight Rayearth also seems to be doing everything right so far with a stacked voice cast including the likes of Ayane Sakura as Hikaru Shido, Rumi Okubo as Umi Ryuzaki, Rie Takahashi as Fu Hooji, Yuki Kaji as Clef, Emiri Kato as Presea, Yoshitsugu Matsuoka as Ferio, Mamiko Noto as Alcyone, Ayumu Murasa as Ascot, Hitomi Ueda as Caldina, and Hiroki Yasumoto as Lafarga. If this strong cast and production team can fully embrace the classic, then it’s going to find a whole new audience for sure.

How are you liking the new Magic Knight Rayearth reboot anime so far? What’s something you hope to see in future episodes? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: New SSS-Class Revival Hunter Trailer Readies for 2027 Crunchyroll Debut – Watch
content:
SSS-Class Revival Hunter is quickly picking up speed for its debut in 2027, and Crunchyroll is showing off what to expect with its first full trailer. Fans might be currently keeping an eye out on everything now making its debut as part of the Fall 2026 anime schedule, but there’s an even bigger wave of anime coming in 2027. Things are looking to start off on a strong foot too as there’s one series that’s hoping to take Solo Leveling crown when it makes its debut with Crunchyroll.

Shin Noah and Bill K.’s SSS-Class Revival Hunter has been a Korean webcomic series that fans have been hoping to see get an official anime adaptation, and we’re starting to see many more of these releases go on to find explosive success . SSS-Class Revival Hunter is set to make its debut next January, and the first full trailer has given fans the first real look at how the series is going to look in motion. You can check it out in action below.

SSS-Class Revival Trailer Teases January 2027 Crunchyroll Release

SSS-Class Revival Hunter is currently scheduled to make its debut next January as part of the Winter 2027 anime schedule , but it has yet to confirm a concrete release date. The series has confirmed, however, that it will be streaming with Crunchyroll exclusively worldwide excluding Asia, with availability in the Indian subcontinent, Indonesia, Singapore, the Philippines, and Malaysia. Hiroaki Sakurai will be directing the series for STUDIO fu. with Sayuri Oba providing the scripts, and Takahiro Yoshimatsu providing the character designs.

SSS-Class Hunter has also revealed much more about the production with this new update too. It’s now been confirmed that Ryo Kawasaki and Tomoyuki Kono will be composing the music for the anime, and THE SPELLBOUND and Boom Boom Satellites will be providing the ending theme for it. It was previously revealed that Takeo Otsuka will be leading the voice cast as the protagonist Gongja Kim, and Satoshi Hino will be the Sword Emperor. But even more new additions have now been confirmed with the launch of this trailer too.

What to Know for SSS-Class Revival Hunter Anime

SSS-Class Hunter will feature a voice cast including the likes of Toshiki Masuda as Flame Emperor, Megumi Han as Witch of the Black Dragon, Sayaka Kinoshita as Paladin, Risa Shimizu as Countess, Makoto Furukawa as Poisonous Viper, Natsumi Fujiwara as Inquisitor, Yuka Iguchi as Master Alchemist, and Shunsuke Sakuya as Blade Saint. But if this ends up being a success, we’re bound to see even more Korean webcomics making their own anime adaptation debuts in the near future.

Crunchyroll has recently kicked off a new partnership with HAYATE and WEBTOON Entertainment’s LINE Digital Frontier Corporation with the intent of developing around 15 Webtoon anime adaptations . Not all of these series will make it to screen, but the hope is that with a new wave of releases it taps into a market that has yet to be fully explored through anime. Series like SSS-Class Revival Hunter already have a ton of readers in their original formats, so it’s time to see whether or not that success translates.

How are you liking the look of the SSS-Class Revival Hunter anime so far? Are you going to check it out when it hits next January? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!
